data.title: 五更琉璃 · 夏夜祭典花火下的日记誓言
data.description: 夏夜神社高耸的石阶之上，漫天花火绽放。黑猫双手死死抓着你的手掌，眼泛晶莹热泪，姬发式黑发在风中舞动。在轰鸣与火光中，她用全部灵魂倾吐出日记里写下的永恒爱慕。
data.location: elevated Shinto shrine stone staircase overlooking illuminated night festival
data.action: standing on shrine stone steps looking at bursting fireworks, tightly clutching partner hand with both hands, tears of joy welling in blue eyes beneath hime cut
data.lighting: multicolored bursts of festival fireworks illuminating the dark summer sky
data.mood: legendary romantic confession, emotional fireworks climax, unforgettable soulmate bond
data.promptProse: On shrine stairs under exploding summer festival fireworks, Ruri Gokou clutches partner hand tightly with both hands, crying tears of passionate joy.
data.animaCaption: Ruri Gokou crying joyful tears under fireworks holding partner hands.
